checks.abstract: PASS; matches the official journal HTML abstract exactly in substance and wording.
checks.metadata: PASS; title, four authors, date, source page, and DOI match the publisher metadata.
checks.research_questions: PASS; the single question is a fair, explicitly interrogative paraphrase of the framework aim.
checks.model: FAIL; this remains an abstract-level synopsis rather than a source-complete extraction. The procedure leaves the defining recommender-phase condition hidden in `recommender_phase(world)`, and omits alpha's Bernoulli participation rule/calibration and S, R_MAX, T_MAX values/roles. It says bounded confidence shifts opinions within epsilon but omits the precise pair update and epsilon/mu semantics; epistemological dynamics are only called communicated observations, with no belief state or update rule. It names recommenders without their scoring definitions/parameters and omits score normalization. Initial opinions are not specified (LFR community opinion plus Bernoulli homophily assignment). The causal comparison, paired control, outcome definitions, and statistical test are compressed to a generic metrics/null/significance statement. Algorithm 1 and cited sections provide these defining details, so the abstractions do not count as a faithful compact model description.
checks.references_and_footnotes: LIMITED; note has 45 reference links, but ordered parity was not checked against the original import snapshot in this audit. r1–r6 are used and defined; locators to the arXiv PDF sections/pages exist and generally cover the statements, though r4 is too broad for the omitted detailed rules.
checks.tags_and_warning: PASS; separate model and simulation list tags; warning remains audit failed pending correction/re-audit.

findings: Replace the opaque recommender_phase helper with the source's alpha/Bernoulli rule, including its calibration, and expose when recommender proposals cease after R_MAX accepted recommendations.
Specify the source-defined opinion state and transition rule for both bounded-confidence and epistemological variants, rather than describing the latter as generic updating from observations.

Include initial opinion generation, the recommender scoring/normalization essentials, and the exact experimental comparison/outcomes/tests at the compact level needed to reproduce the framework. Use locators to Algorithm 1 and the relevant §3, §§4–5 passages.
